name: Cache 故障排查

unboundedCache.issue: HashMap无上限/无超时/无LRU→Old区持续涨

noHashEquals.issue: 自定义Key没重写equals+hashCode→put进去get不出来→隐式泄漏

fdLeak.issue: 文件/连接close不在finally→fd泄漏→Too many open files

content.diagnosis: jstat→Old持续涨→jmap dump→MAT Dominator Tree→找大对象→看GC Root链

notes: Cache泄漏三场景：无界缓存/HashMap key缺hashCode-equals/fd泄漏；修复=Guava+弱引用+重写hashCode/equals+try-with-resources
